`comment("Splunk SPL for Transaction Amount Clustering Near Reporting Threshold")`

index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT" OR event_type="CASH_DEPOSIT")
transaction_amount>=9000

transaction_amount>=2800

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Split Transfer Chain Detection")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_large_inbound | near selection_multiple_outbound by account_id | count(distinct beneficiary_id) by account_id > 2")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:wire_system
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT")
transaction_amount>=25000
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT" OR event_type="INTERNAL_TRANSFER")
transaction_amount<10000
| stats dc(beneficiary_id) as unique_beneficiary_id by account_id
| where unique_beneficiary_id > 2
rules.title: DL-0029: Split Transfer Chain Detection (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: Beneficiary Country Mismatch with Business Profile
status: experimental
description: Detects wire transfers to countries where the account holder has no established business relationship or prior transaction history. Combined with other indicators, this can reveal business email compr
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: wire_system
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "WIRE_INITIATION"
        wire_type: "international"
        beneficiary_country_in_business_profile: false
        transaction_amount|gte: 5000
    filter_consumer_remittance:
        account_type: "personal"
        transaction_amount|lt: 3000
    condition: selection and not filter_consumer_remittance
level: high
rules.title: DL-0032: Beneficiary Country Mismatch with Business Profile (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Wire to FATF High-Risk Jurisdiction
status: experimental
description: Detects wire transfers to jurisdictions on the FATF high-risk or increased monitoring lists. While not inherently fraudulent, wires to these jurisdictions combined with other risk factors (new benefic
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: wire_system
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "WIRE_INITIATION"
        wire_type: "international"
        beneficiary_country:
            - "MM"
            - "KP"
            - "IR"
            - "YE"
            - "SY"
            - "HT"
            - "VU"
            - "PH"
            - "NG"
            - "SS"
        transaction_amount|gte: 1000
    filter_established_relationship:
        beneficiary_relationship_days|gte: 365
        prior_transaction_count|gte: 10
    condition: selection and not filter_established_relationship
level: high
rules.title: DL-0035: Wire to FATF High-Risk Jurisdiction (Sigma)
